finalists.label: Giant cell tumor
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence, including a lytic lesion of the frontal bone with a soap-bubble appearance and a lobulated frontal-bone mass.

finalists.label: Osteoma
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence in its group, including a painless mass on the right side of the frontal bone and a large, circumscribed radiolucent lesion.

finalists.label: Hemangioma
finalists.why: It has the most specific for evidence in its group, including a lytic lesion of the frontal bone with a soap-bubble appearance and avid enhancement on postcontrast sequences.

frontier_selector.why: The soap-bubble appearance and cortical destruction of the inner and outer tables are more characteristic of a Giant cell tumor.
